svg.text: Your retina has ~6M cones (RGB) + ~120M rods (gray). The printer has 5760×1440 dots.
Moiré — interference patterns reveal printer physics
• Your L-cones see red, M-cones green, S-cones blue (trichromatic)
• Printer uses C(anti-red) M(anti-green) Y(anti-blue) K(all-absorb)
• The delta between digital source and scanned result = the epitope
• Paper absorbs/reflects differently than a screen emits
• This IS immunology: present known antigen → measure response → learn
